ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name = "Private Terminal Service", ISPICKVAL( Private_Terminal_Type__c , "LAPS"), OR( ISBLANK(Nationality_Region__c), ISBLANK(Passport_No__c), ISBLANK(Passport_Expiry_Date__c), ISBLANK(Birthday__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Language_Preference_LAPS_Only__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When Private Terminal Type = LAPS, following fields can't be empty: "Nationality/Region", "Passport No.", "Passport Expiry Date", "Birthday", "Language Preference (LAPS Only)"
